messages.author: dfd3eaa4a0813853
messages.subject: How to add the third party package in Rhipe
parts:
Hi guys,
              i am trying to add the third party package in my map-reduce program. it is not set perfectly, it through object not found error. what are the ways i followed means
First-way:

#setup
setup<- expression({
reduce={
library(biganalytics)
library(biglm)
library(bigmemory)
}
})

second:

setup<- expression({
library(biganalytics)
library(biglm)
library(bigmemory)
})

Third way:

#Setup
setup<- expression({
map=expression({
home.Rlib <- "/usr/lib/R/lib"
invisible(.libPaths(c(home.Rlib,.libPaths())))
}),
reduce=expression({
home.Rlib <- "/usr/lib/R/lib"
invisible(.libPaths(c(home.Rlib,.libPaths())))
library(biganalytics)
library(biglm)
library(bigmemory)
})
})
                   i tried all the three ways. still my problem was not rectified.my doubt "is this setup code is correct". if it is wrong can you please guide me to write the correct setup code. my Rhipe revision is 0.7.31.( i am using rhwatch())
Note: i installed the all the required package in all datanodes.

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Re: How to add the third party package in Rhipe
parts:
do this

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library( ...))

some packages print messages to stderror which gets interpreted s errors.
Other packages startup silently. So to be on the safe side, just call
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(whatever))
